ITEM 1 | Leafy greens, mostly pale green to dark green curly/ruffled leaves with crisp edges, forming a loose heap covering roughly 35% of the plate in the left-center; some leaves show yellowish-cream inner tones; no visible dressing sheen | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-cream chunks with slightly soft, moist surface and a few small pieces, about 3 cm across, sitting at the left edge of the greens | 25
ITEM 3 | Thin strips of red and orange bell pepper, glossy and slightly limp, with some green pepper strips mixed in, spread across about 15% of the right side of the plate | 30
ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-brown to black kidney-shaped beans, whole and smooth, about 1.5 cm long each, five or six scattered on the upper right and among the greens | 15
